options: Data that has been archived and is no longer accessible
A dataset prepared to business requirements, readily available at one click and needing no further cleansing or wrangling
Raw data copied as-is into a landing zone
questions.explanation: Canned Data is readily available at one click: a dataset prepared to business requirements that needs no more cleansing, wrangling or reconciliation.

questions.stem: What is the aim of Canned Data?
options: That users can just click and data is served
That data is encrypted before storage
That data scientists can build their own models from raw data
That analysts can wrangle the data themselves
That data is kept for regulatory retention
questions.explanation: The aim is for a user simply to click and have the data served, with no further preparation required.

questions.stem: Which analogy explains Canned Data in *I Am Datapedia!*?
options: Canned food, which is prepared and sealed to be used anytime, anywhere, by anyone
questions.explanation: Like canned food that is ready to eat anytime and anywhere, canned data is ready to use.

questions.stem: Which structure is given as a perfect example of Canned Data?
questions.explanation: OLAP Cubes are a perfect example of canned data, storing pre-calculated and pre-aggregated data in a multi-dimensional table ready to be consumed.

questions.stem: What kind of data does an OLAP Cube store, making it Canned Data?
options: Pre-calculated and pre-aggregated data in a multi-dimensional table
questions.explanation: OLAP Cubes hold pre-calculated and pre-aggregated data in a multi-dimensional table, ready to be consumed at any time.

options: No, it is static once created
Only by adding new data elements
Only by rebuilding the whole data warehouse
Yes, with the latest data using the same existing data elements
questions.explanation: The key phrase is that canned data can be refreshed with the latest data using the same existing data element.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT something Canned Data is meant to need?
options: A refresh with the latest data
questions.explanation: Canned data needs no more cleansing, wrangling, reconciliation or manual preparation, but it can and should be refreshed with the latest data.

questions.stem: In what format might Canned Data be prepared if the business requires it?
questions.explanation: Canned data is a dataset prepared to business requirements, for example in pre-aggregated form, in one accessible format.

questions.stem: Which phrase best describes the readiness of Canned Data?
questions.explanation: Just as most canned food is ready to eat, canned data is ready to use.

questions.stem: What is the basis on which a Canned Dataset is prepared?
options: The order in which data arrived
questions.explanation: Canned data is a dataset prepared based on business requirements so that it is ready at one click.
